name: table

frames.best_why: Whole invoice table is visible with every row, the total footer and the caption, and no cursor in the way.

tagline: Invoice rows on a dark panel light up as the pointer sweeps down.
summary: A five-column invoice table with a small header row, five customer records, a shaded total footer and a caption underneath. Each row tints grey when hovered.
appearance: A dark rounded panel on a near-black stage holds a five-column invoice layout: Invoice, Customer, Status, Method and a right-aligned Amount. Header labels are small grey caps, rows are split by faint lines, the Total footer sits in a slightly lighter band and a centred caption closes the bottom.
behaviour: Hovering a body row fills its full width with a lighter grey, and as the pointer moves down the records each one highlights in turn. The footer keeps its own shade and nothing opens or expands.
demo_content: Five invoices for Alex Thompson, Sarah Chen, James Wilson, Maria Garcia and David Kim.
search_phrases: invoice list with columns and a total
simple data grid with header row
grid with footer total and caption
list of payments and their status
use_when: You need to show many comparable records across several columns with a summary total.
avoid_when: On narrow screens the five columns squeeze; sorting, filtering and paging are not built in.
customise: Each export is a thin wrapper over an HTML element, so rows and cells arrive as children; colours and the row highlight come from theme classes you can override with className.
weight_why: Plain table elements styled with utility classes; no script runs.

a11y.note: Semantic table markup includes a caption, but header cells have no scope attribute and the hover highlight has no keyboard path.

polish_why: Clean dark styling and tidy alignment, but it is a plainly dressed table.
title: Table
